column4: I wish I didn't have to change the tyres! I always have to spend ages at the pit stop!

column4: Sandra keeps transferring all the calls from English people to Juan, but I'll put a stop to that!

column4: The staff in the 5-star resort certainly pulled out all the stops to impress us after realizing that I had a gold card!

column4: The director was incredible and she pulled out all the stops so that the show would dazzle everyone!

column4: A head start might even out his chances of winning.

column4: If the crook had had a head start, he would've gotten away for sure.

column4: You fell asleep but I watched that dreadful movie from start to finish.
